name: tally-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your TallyPrime books (read-only).
long_description:
Lets Claude read ledgers, balances, trial balance, stock summary and day book from a running TallyPrime / Tally.ERP 9 through Tally's built-in XML gateway. Strictly read-only: it never creates, alters or deletes anything in Tally. Data stays on your PC and goes only between Tally and Claude.

Before use: open TallyPrime with a company loaded and enable the gateway — F1 (Help) > Settings > Connectivity > Client/Server configuration > 'TallyPrime acts as' = Both, Port = 9000.
